name: The Tome of Valor
label: Quest

intro: This quest marks the conclusion of the trials of valor set forth by the Church of the Holy Light in Stormwind. After defending the isolated Stilwell homestead from bandits in Westfall, an aspiring paladin returns to Duthorian Rall to report Daphne's safety. It cements the sacred duty of the paladin to serve as a selfless shield for the innocent.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Please, return to Duthorian and let him know that I'm safe for now. I have you and the Church to thank for that.
He'll send word to Ironforge to let my Jordan know that he has nothing to fear.
Oh, how I miss my husband. I can't wait till he returns.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, we meet again, friend, and you are in high spirits, I see.
The Stilwell home will be safe for another day, and from your story I see that there was no shortage of danger to be found. Well done.
Daphne and Jordan have helped the Church greatly, and having you protect their property—and their very lives—was the least we could do for them.
For your valor, you will be rewarded.
